posts.name: NitroStack
posts.tagline: Build, test, and deploy MCP servers in one place
posts.description: NitroStack is the full-stack platform for building production-ready MCP servers and AI apps. Build with open-source TypeScript & Python SDKs, test and debug visually in NitroStack Studio, orchestrate agent workflows with NitroStack Workflow, deploy on NitroStack Cloud, and ship branded experiences with NitroStack Chat. Auth, testing, deployment and frontend stay in one workflow. Connect to ChatGPT, Claude and other AI clients. Powering 80,000+ MCP servers.

posts.name: Caldera
posts.tagline: Your Obsidian vault as a living profile and linked garden
posts.description: Caldera turns your Obsidian vault into a public page that updates itself, and a digital garden of notes you grow in public. Plant a note and it becomes a page marked seedling, budding or evergreen, with a license you choose. Link to a note in a friend's garden and the backlink appears on theirs. Private by default: nothing leaves your vault unless you choose it, and contact details are stripped. Free, open source and self-hostable.

posts.name: Notion: Context for your agents
posts.tagline: Switch AI agents without re-explaining your work
posts.description: Notion 3.8 turns your workspace into the shared context layer for every AI agent your team uses. Unlike chat tools that start from zero each time you switch models, Notion keeps your docs, databases, and Skills in one place any MCP agent can read and update. Connect Claude, ChatGPT, or any MCP agent, plug Notion Agents into 150+ tools, sync Skills everywhere with the new Skills API, and see every agent edit in upgraded version history. Plus column permissions and rebuilt synced databases.

posts.name: Emochi
posts.tagline: Voice journal to understand yourself through art and science
posts.description: Emochi turns your voice notes into a living, generative character that reflects your emotional world. Vent about your day, untangle a thought, or check in with yourself. Your words are transcribed instantly, helping you notice patterns in how you feel. Built by a doctor, a designer, and two AI engineers, Emochi brings affective science and playful art to private, non-clinical self-reflection. Start with a voice note. Meet your Mochi.

posts.name: Train with Pasta
posts.tagline: A personal trainer powered by Apple Intelligence
posts.description: Pasta is a personal trainer in your pocket. Ask for "a 30 minute upper body workout", and it'll build it for you. While you train, the app uses voice as a guide, so you can focus on pushing yourself hard. It does plans too! Tell it what you're training for and it writes a plan around the days you can train. The app runs on Apple Intelligence and needs no account. Your progress and health data stays on your device. Requires an iPhone with Apple Intelligence on iOS 27.

posts.name: Craft Agents
posts.tagline: The world's most powerful agents, with the UX they deserve
posts.description: Craft Agents is fully open source and runs locally on your machine — your data and keys never leave it. Bring any AI provider: Claude, GPT, Gemini, or local models. Agents connect to your real tools (MCP, APIs, local files) and act across all of them. Code diffs, data tables, diagrams, and live previews render inline. Turn results into persistent Pages, teach reusable Skills, and run Automations on a schedule — all in a desktop UX you can actually live in.

posts.name: LooGo
posts.tagline: Find public restrooms fast
posts.description: LooGo helps you find public restrooms instantly when you're out in the city. Built natively for Android and Wear OS using OpenStreetMap data, it gives you quick access to door codes, pricing, opening hours, and accessibility details. No ads, no tracking, and no bloat just fast offline maps and a companion Wear OS app so you can find a spot directly from your wrist.

posts.name: GPU Terminal by Context.dev
posts.tagline: Compare GPU rental prices across cloud providers
posts.description: GPU cloud pricing is scattered across dozens of providers. GPU Terminal brings recent hourly rates into one dashboard. Pick your GPU, compare provider offers, explore price history, and check original sources. Open source and built by Context.dev.

posts.name: Ultracite v8
posts.tagline: The linter and formatter for agentic development
posts.description: Agents write most of the code now. Ultracite is the linter and formatter for agentic development, a zero-config preset for Oxlint, Biome, and ESLint that keeps agent-written code consistent and type-safe. Ultracite checks every edit agents make against hundreds of strict rules in under half a second, so what reaches review is consistent, type-safe code instead of slop. Used by engineering teams at OpenAI, Vercel, Mintlify, and thousands of open source projects: ultracite.ai

posts.name: Unfenced
posts.tagline: Land for sale that actually borders public land
posts.description: Checks ~700,000 U.S. listings every week against official public-land maps and shows the ~13,600 homes and land parcels that actually touch national forest, BLM and state land. Each one is measured from its county parcel boundary: the shared edge in feet, drawn on a map, plus how much public land is behind it, elevation, road access, flood zone and wildfire hazard. Search by ZIP or state. Free, no account needed.

posts.name: Spiralens
posts.tagline: Golden ratio camera that tells you where to move your phone
posts.description: Spiralens is an Android camera for people who never learned composition. Tap your subject, follow the arrow, and shoot when the ring turns green: the subject sits on the golden point and the phone is level. Guides for golden spiral, phi grid, rule of thirds, symmetry and horizon. The editor adds a golden-ratio crop, straighten, drag-to-crop and a new background blur that keeps your target sharp. Works offline; photos never leave your phone.

posts.name: Earnote
posts.tagline: Lecture & meeting notes, written on your device
posts.description: Record a lecture, meeting or your own explanation – Earnote transcribes it with Whisper and writes a structured note with tasks, flashcards and a PDF study sheet. Speech recognition runs on your iPhone, iPad or Mac, and on iPhone 15 Pro and later even the note is written on-device. No account, no ads, no subscription. Free and open source (MIT); optional one-time Pro on iPhone/iPad.

posts.name: Draper
posts.tagline: Validate, plan, and launch a business, one step at a time.
posts.description: Turn your idea into a real product. Use Draper to find out if your idea holds up, and then work through the next steps: business plan, brand, product, landing page, first customers — all in one place.

posts.name: Korinotch
posts.tagline: Your MacBook notch, turned into a command center
posts.description: Media HUD, notifications, file tray, clipboard, keep awake, keyboard lock and widgets, all in the notch. Native SwiftUI for macOS 14+. Free for 14 days, then $11.50 lifetime. Eleven of the utilities are free standalone menu-bar apps.

posts.name: Salience
posts.tagline: See every request to your website and how it responds.
posts.description: Salience turns the server and CDN data you already generate into a live view of every request, response and issue, from people, search engines and AI bots.

posts.name: Step 5 Preview
posts.tagline: 600B open weights, trained for long-running agents
posts.description: Step 5 Preview is StepFun's open-weight MoE for coding, financial research and long-running agents. It has 600B total parameters, 27B active per token and a 1M-token context, with deployment support for vLLM, SGLang and Transformers.

posts.name: Parrot
posts.tagline: Smart Meeting Assistant for Mac that helps during the call
posts.description: Parrot is a free, open-source meeting recorder for Mac that helps during the call, not after it. No bot joins: it records what your Mac hears and transcribes on device. When a client asks something your pricing sheet or FAQ covers, the answer appears with the file it came from. After the call you get a report of promises made and questions missed, and you can chat with all your meetings. Use Claude, a free local model with Ollama, or your own server. No account, no subscription.

posts.name: CrewTower Mod for Claude Code
posts.tagline: Talk to Claude Code right from your MacBook notch
posts.description: A Claude Code mod that links every Claude session to CrewTower in your Mac's notch. Type Claude's next prompt on its card, stop the turn, compact it, and see what fills its context. Terminal and Claude Desktop. Stays on your Mac, off until you turn it on.

posts.name: Leepik
posts.tagline: Bank PDFs to Tally, with ledger mapping that learns
posts.description: Turn bank-statement PDFs into Tally-ready accounting entries. Built for Indian accountants. Open beta: anyone can join, with all features free throughout beta. Leepik learns your ledger choices, reducing repeat work each month. Review balance checks and ledger suggestions, then export Tally XML or CSV. Statements are processed on Leepik's own servers, never sent to third-party AI or OCR services. Text-based PDFs only; scanned PDFs aren't supported.

posts.name: NEWCV.IO
posts.tagline: Stand out. Get interviews.
posts.description: NEWCV.IO is a career application platform for building, tailoring and auditing professional resumes. Create from scratch, import your existing career information, use Role to Resume to generate around a target role, Job Matcher Resume to tailor for a specific vacancy, and Premium Resume Audit for ATS and recruiter focused feedback. Includes professional templates, personal branding and multilingual resume tools.

posts.name: 10X.ing
posts.tagline: Get new customers for your startup - on autopilot
posts.description: Enter your website and automatically get marketing opportunities across cold email, social content, SEO, backlinks and AI/LLM SEO.

posts.name: KuikCode
posts.tagline: Beautiful QR codes you'll never reprint
posts.description: Create dynamic QR codes with branded designs, change the destination after printing, generate bulk QR code batches from a CSV, and track every scan in realtime. KuikCode makes dynamic QR codes that look like your brand and keep working after you print them. Change where a code points anytime, send scans to a mobile page you build here, and see every scan. Unlimited scans on every plan, from $5 a month.

posts.name: Laundro Cafe
posts.tagline: A cozy focus timer in a laundromat shared with strangers
posts.description: Laundro Cafe is a quiet, shared laundromat in your browser. Start a washer or dryer as a focus timer, play lofi on the TV, brew coffee, and leave a handwritten note for a stranger. See other visitors through their spinning machines. Free, no sign-up.

posts.name: RefurbMe Import Costs
posts.tagline: What a US purchase really costs delivered to 16 countries
posts.description: Buying in the US and shipping home? See forwarder fees, shipping, duty and tax for 16 countries, with 6 US forwarders ranked by delivered total. Phones, laptops, clothes and more. Every page links its sources. Free, no signup.

posts.name: Killer Krakens
posts.tagline: One boat. Depth charges. The whole deep rising at you.
posts.description: Killer Krakens is a free browser arcade game from The Night Crew, our animated show about janitors in space. In the pilot, the crew plays this game — so we built it for real. One boat, a rack of depth charges, and the whole deep rising to meet you. Arrows steer, Space drops a charge, K lights a thunder keg. Scores save in your browser. No ads, no sign-up, no download — and it's in open beta on iPhone via TestFlight too.

posts.name: OptimAI Studio
posts.tagline: Your AI creative agent, from idea to final cut
posts.description: Turn an idea into a connected creative project. Direct an AI agent to plan films, generate images, video and music, then refine them in a browser editor. Create illustrated stories, publish websites and build playable games—all in OptimAI Studio.

posts.name: WorkerDock
posts.tagline: All your local Cloudflare Workers projects in one Mac app
posts.description: Free, open source Mac app for local Cloudflare Workers. It finds your Workers, Pages, Astro and EmDash projects, starts and stops them on a free port, streams their logs, and shows the D1, KV and R2 bindings each one uses. Lives in your menu bar. Native Swift, private, no Electron.

posts.name: Nemotron 3.5 Bolt
posts.tagline: Run everyday agentic tasks locally on a 24GB GPU
posts.description: Nemotron 3.5 Bolt 24GB is NVIDIA’s model for running everyday agentic tasks locally on NVIDIA RTX and DGX Spark hardware. It compresses Nemotron 3.5 Super VL from 120B total, 12B active to 74B total, 9B active, sized to fit a 24GB memory budget. NVIDIA reports 84 tokens per second on RTX Spark. Text and vision. Checkpoints, GGUF files, and a speculative-decoding drafter are on Hugging Face.

posts.name: HonestExpenses AI
posts.tagline: Say what you spent. AI helps. It's tracked. Any platform.
posts.description: Say it, snap it or text it: expenses tracked in seconds with AI. One sentence becomes several transactions, a receipt photo becomes its lines, a Telegram message is saved in two taps. AI only drafts; you check. No bank login, no ads. Free to start. 7 days pro for Free

posts.name: OKstays
posts.tagline: Hotels ranked by real comfort, not commission
posts.description: Tired of noisy rooms, broken AC and uncomfy beds? OKstays scores 30,000+ hotels in 199 destinations on 67 comfort signals, like quiet, beds, shower, WiFi and AC, and ranks them by one Comfort Score. A hotel that fails a must-have (clean, comfy bed, good shower, bug-free, safe area) never gets ranked. Pick a travel style or the exact signals you need and get a shortlist with strengths and caveats. Also works inside Claude, ChatGPT and Grok. Free, no sign-up, and hotels can't pay to rank.

posts.name: Needl Vinyl
posts.tagline: Your vinyl collection, with live lyrics from your turntable
posts.description: Most vinyl apps stop at cataloging. Needl is built for the moment you drop the needle. Put a record on, tap Listen, and Live Lyrics follow along in time with your turntable. Scan a barcode or the sleeve to find your exact pressing and what it's worth. Connect Apple Music, Spotify or TIDAL to see your streaming next to your shelf, and and ask Siri what your collection is worth. Native on iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch and Apple TV, and free to download.

posts.name: Rafiky
posts.tagline: AI Infrastructure for Global Tourism
posts.description: Rafiky is an AI-powered intelligence platform for global tourism, combining a travel marketplace, specialized business software, AI agents, and data-driven insights. Travelers discover and book local experiences, while tourism providers manage bookings, operations, payments, and analytics through dedicated software. Rafiky’s AI agents help automate workflows and improve decision-making, connecting travelers, businesses, and tourism data in one integrated ecosystem to drive growth and efficiency.

posts.name: Lighthouse
posts.tagline: Follow a glowing lighthouse to slow your breathing
posts.description: Lighthouse is a one-screen breathing session. A lamp brightens as you breathe in for four seconds and softens as you breathe out for six, while a quiet voice, the Keeper, says a few words at the right moments and then goes silent. Choose 90 seconds, 5 or 10 minutes. No account, no sign-up, nothing to download. Switch Sound off and the light carries on alone.

posts.name: Atonomuse
posts.tagline: Your Instagram and Facebook, written and posted for you
posts.description: Paste your website. Atonomuse learns how your business talks, then makes image posts, carousels and animated reels for Instagram and Facebook, and publishes them on your schedule. A critic scores every post before it can go out and sends weak ones back to be rewritten. Approve each post from your phone, or let the good ones go out on their own. Free plan: one post and one carousel on your own brand, no card.

posts.name: Scowld
posts.tagline: An open-source AI companion for voice, vision and chat
posts.description: Meet Scowld, an open-source AI companion for iPhone and iPad. Talk or type with an animated character, add optional camera context, customize its name and personality, and revisit chats saved on your device. Bring your own AI and speech provider keys, stored in iOS Keychain. Provider usage charges may apply.

posts.name: Almirah
posts.tagline: A little cabinet that lives on your Mac’s desktop
posts.description: Almirah is a little cabinet that lives on your Mac’s desktop. Drop in documents, screenshots, files, photos, videos and notes, keep private ones in a Touch ID locker, and drag them out whenever a form asks.

posts.name: ShareSwitch
posts.tagline: Switch what you screen-share without stopping the share
posts.description: ShareSwitch mirrors any window into one window you share in Teams, Zoom or Meet. Hold Ctrl+Alt and click another window: your call sees it instantly, without topping or re-sharing. Free, open source, no account. Windows 10 & 11.

posts.name: Lyrumi
posts.tagline: AI Song Generator & Creator Social Network
posts.description: Write what the song is about (a feeling, an inside joke, a name), pick a genre, and Lyrumi makes the whole thing: lyrics, music, vocals and cover art, in 9 languages. Then share it: publish to the feed of new songs, climb the charts, read comments from listeners, or send a private link to one person.

posts.name: CalorTracker
posts.tagline: Snap what you ate. Plan what's next. Track your health
posts.description: Log a meal by photo, voice or text, then let CalorTracker plan what's next: the meals you have left today, on the calories you have left, or a whole week with batch prep, where you cook once and get the macros for every portion. Stuck? Ask Pepperly, the free AI coach that knows your last week of food, water and workouts. Friends compete on days logged, not weight, and nothing is public. Also: voice logging in 20 languages, Health Connect and widgets. No ads, a real free tier. Android and web.

posts.name: BuiltList
posts.tagline: The home of everything built in Sri Lanka
posts.description: BuiltList is the home for products, AI agents and bots built by Sri Lankans. Finding local tools used to mean scattered Facebook posts and word of mouth. Now it's one searchable place. Ask AI search finds what you need in plain words, and you can browse Featured, Most upvoted, Just launched, and Agents & bots. Listing is free and hand-reviewed in about 24 hours. 420 founders and 91 live products so far. Built in Sri Lanka.

posts.name: Bloom — Coffee Timer & Journal
posts.tagline: Track your beans, time each brew, fix the next cup
posts.description: Bloom keeps your coffee shelf, brew timer, and journal in one iPhone app. Add a bag’s roast date to see an estimated flavor window, follow a timed recipe, then rate the cup. Brew Coach turns sour, bitter, weak, or strong into one grind, dose, or water change to try next. Each brew subtracts grams from the bag. Bag scanning runs on-device (iOS 26+). No account; optional iCloud sync. Free for 3 coffees and 5 recipes; Pro removes the limits.

posts.name: GiftCrew
posts.tagline: Shared wishlists where friends claim gifts in secret
posts.description: Create and share birthday wishlists with friends and family. Organize Secret Santa draws, coordinate gift-giving, and avoid duplicate gifts.

posts.name: Lumovi
posts.tagline: A calm, fast Kubernetes dashboard for you, your team and AI
posts.description: Every Kubernetes cluster you have, what's failing first. On your desktop, or in your cluster for your team, each as themselves. Any AI agent can work through it over MCP, and by default asks you before a change. Free, open source, no telemetry, no account.

posts.name: Altair Finance
posts.tagline: Privacy-first personal finance app for macOS.
posts.description: Your finances stay on your Mac, with no bank and no cloud in the middle. Altair keeps net worth, transactions, and budgets in an encrypted file you unlock yourself. Update it manually, or turn on a local MCP and let your agent use and update the books.

posts.name: WordNet Explorer
posts.tagline: See how words relate, by meaning and by real-world usage
posts.description: WordNet Explorer is a visual NLP toolkit for English words. Explore synsets and relations, analyze text, map semantic networks, and compare words by meaning (WordNet) and real-world usage (embeddings), with a plain-English verdict. Free JSON API included.

posts.name: Warden
posts.tagline: Lock your Mac’s input. Let your AI agents keep working.
posts.description: Step away while an AI agent, build, or render keeps running. Press ⇧⌘L and Warden blocks keyboard, mouse, trackpad, and gestures on every display, so a bumped key, kid, or cat can’t interrupt. Show progress or blur the screen, keep the Mac awake, and unlock with Touch ID or your password. It guards against accidental input; it doesn’t replace the macOS lock screen. 7-day free trial, then $8.99 once for up to 3 Macs. macOS 15.2+.

posts.name: Barkme
posts.tagline: Uptime monitoring for websites, applications and APIs
posts.description: Barkme watches your sites and APIs from the outside and barks where your team already lives: Slack, Telegram, email, Linear, Trello or a signed webhook. Linear issues and Trello cards open on downtime and close themselves on recovery. Daily SSL, domain-expiry and blacklist checks catch outages that aren’t crashes. Status pages included. Free forever for 3 monitors, no card. Paid plan for 5 verified domains and 30-sec checks starts from $19/mo.

posts.name: Milk the Money:Proven Business Ideas
posts.tagline: Find and test a business idea in a day
posts.description: Research tool for picking a business idea with proof of demand. Filter 1,500 real small businesses by budget, team size, and build time; see how each one gets customers; then run its day-one test. Stuck? Hit Shuffle. 20 ideas free, no account.

posts.name: Lilac
posts.tagline: Your teammate that finishes things ahead of you.
posts.description: Your AI teammate for research, building projects, and everyday tasks. Lilac works with your tools, remembers your context, and follows through on the next step.

posts.name: AlienMail
posts.tagline: AI-first outreach. Upload leads, hit send, AI does the rest
posts.description: Most outreach tools make you do the work: write sequences, configure warmup, guess send timing. Alien Mail flips that. Alien AI learns your business, writes your sequences, and sets up warmup and send timing automatically. You upload your leads and hit send. What's different: • AI-first, not AI-assisted — setup is done for you • Pay-as-you-go credits, unlimited warmup, free team seats • Native apps for Android, iOS, Mac and Windows • MCP support, so your AI agents can run outreach too

posts.name: Mediora AI
posts.tagline: Your content, without the content grind
posts.description: Creating content shouldn’t mean writing the same idea five different ways. Mediora AI helps you turn one thought into tailored, publish-ready content for different platforms while preserving the meaning and voice behind it. We’ve rebuilt the experience around a faster workflow, giving creators, founders, and marketers fewer prompts to manage, less rewriting to do, and more time to focus on what they want to say.

posts.name: Hivelane
posts.tagline: Air traffic control for your coding agents
posts.description: Your main coding agent stays in charge. Hivelane routes each task to the agent that fits it, gives every worker its own git worktree, and hands work on when a seat runs low. One local memory for every agent. Windows, Linux, macOS beta.

posts.name: VerbX: AI Translate & Chat
posts.tagline: Talk Local. Listen Global
posts.description: VerbX Personal helps people communicate across languages through voice, video calls, text, camera translation, offline language packs, phrasebooks, and AI assistance. It is built for everyday multilingual communication, not just one-off translation. Users can speak, read, message, learn, and stay connected across languages from one app, with free access for core use and optional Premium and Pro features.

posts.name: LLMGrid
posts.tagline: The Unified LLM Gateway
posts.description: LLMGrid is a unified AI gateway connecting multiple LLM providers through one API. Bring your own keys for OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Groq, Mistral, and more. Route requests, configure automatic fallbacks, switch models seamlessly, create virtual API keys, and manage access and budgets. Monitor usage, costs, latency, and logs from one dashboard without provider lock-in. **Get started for free and scale as you grow.**

posts.name: Checko
posts.tagline: Detect AI Generated Images & Deepfakes for Free
posts.description: Checko tells you if an image was made or edited by AI. Upload a photo or paste a link, and Checko gives you a verdict with the reason, in one plain line. It works on AI-generated pictures, face swaps and deepfakes. 3 free checks a day, no sign-up.

posts.name: Beyond Payday
posts.tagline: Know what’s left. Plan what’s next. No bank linking.
posts.description: See what’s left each month, and what a new job, a house, a baby or paying off debt would change. No bank linking. Find bills to cut, see prices in hours of work, and how long you’d last without a paycheck. Share with a partner and track net worth, goals and debt payoff. Pro plans retirement month by month up to age 100, even after you retire, with Social Security, pensions and 10,000 Monte Carlo runs, plus Beth, an AI assistant. Or connect ChatGPT or Claude. Free plan; 30-day Pro trial, no card.

posts.name: mantid
posts.tagline: Vibe train AI models on your own data. Free, on your Mac.
posts.description: Vibe train AI models from the spreadsheets and documents you already have. Predict which customers will leave or what you’ll sell next month, or train your own LLM on your company’s docs. No code. Every model tested. Free, private, runs on your Mac.

posts.name: Qeno AI
posts.tagline: Real-looking UGC video ads. No creators needed.
posts.description: Hiring creators for UGC ads is slow and costly, especially for small brands. Qeno AI makes UGC-style video ads from your product, so you can test fresh creatives every week. Built by a 22-year-old student founder in India for small businesses and growing brands. We're early, so honest feedback means a lot.

posts.name: Crember - AI Influencer Search
posts.tagline: Describe the creator you want. We’ll find them.
posts.description: Your creator database is lying to you. Crember isn’t. 7 years of agency know-how, turned into one tool. Type “dad who cooks with his kids” and find them from thousands of hand-vetted creators. Stories auto-saved. Posts tracked. Insights live.

posts.name: Butla
posts.tagline: Your AI butler for everyday life. Live on your terms
posts.description: Your AI butler for everyday life. Acts on your behalf, coordinates & keeps your day organized, handles tasks across work and home, and catches what you'd miss. Learns how you live: your routines and preferences to get things done your way. Talk to your butler to research, create, coordinate, book, and buy, with your approval where it matters. Now open to everyone.

posts.name: APPLORE
posts.tagline: Make your app icon, animate it, ship store screenshots
posts.description: APPLORE helps you make your app's look in one place. Browse 18,000+ real App Store and Google Play icons, make your own icon with AI, let AI turn your logo into a Lottie or SVG animation for your splash screen, and design store screenshots in every size. Free to start: new accounts get 50 credits, and the screenshot generator is free with no sign-up.

posts.name: Bitty
posts.tagline: While AI works, work your brain.
posts.description: Tiny brain games for the waits while Claude Code, Cursor or ChatGPT works. A pixel buddy for your desktop, free for Mac, Windows and Linux.

posts.name: Interfaces for Humans
posts.tagline: Test the interfaces your AI generates, before anyone clicks
posts.description: More AI products now build screens on the fly: a chat answer becomes a form, a table, a booking flow. Nobody reviewed that screen, and it's different every time. RUI tests these generated interfaces both proactive and reactive (evals): it lists every button and form, what each says it does, what it actually does, and where to fix it. Also in the lab: Agentable UI, an open-source agent-native library for people and AI agents. A person sees a table to sort; their agent sees a tool it can call.

posts.name: Workstreams by Binary Decimal
posts.tagline: Plan your whole week, not just work. Free, no account.
posts.description: Workstreams is a free planner for your whole week. Split projects into streams and tasks, block out time, and add habits like a workout or a meditation that tick themselves off when you finish. It runs in your browser, with no account.

posts.name: Tablom
posts.tagline: iPad weekly planner for LGS students — private & on-device
posts.description: Tablom is an iPad-first weekly study planner for Turkish LGS students. Build a real weekly timetable, set 5 weekly goals, track question nets per subject, and check off 53 LGS topics — all stored on-device. Teachers can leave notes via a web link without installing the app. No account required to start; privacy-first and built for landscape iPad.

posts.name: Emblee
posts.tagline: Understand everyday language - with grammar and context
posts.description: Learn German, Brazilian Portuguese and Thai through structured lessons, clear grammar and spaced review. Ask AI to explain your answer or recheck a valid alternative, then practise with AI-generated pronunciation audio at normal or slower speed. Start with free lessons on the web; paid plans unlock more.

posts.name: Melodic Strings
posts.tagline: Play string textures and layer orchestral ideas online
posts.description: Sketch a string part without opening a full production session. Choose orchestral-style sounds, play in automatic chord or chromatic modes, and shape the result with effects. Use MIDI input, record and layer parts, and export clips when an arrangement starts to take shape. Melodic Strings is a focused instrument for composers, arrangers and musical exploration. Works in the browser, with free features and optional paid upgrades. Also available on Android.

posts.name: SourceXray
posts.tagline: See the exact campaign and keyword behind every lead
posts.description: SourceXray attaches the full source to every form submission: channel, campaign, exact paid keyword, landing page and the first visit that found you, including visits from ChatGPT and Perplexity. One script or the WordPress plugin, no form rebuilds. Leads go to email, Slack, HubSpot or GoHighLevel with the source filled in, and back to Google Ads and Meta so bidding finds more real enquiries. AI Tracking Setup builds your GA4 and Tag Manager lead tracking from a plain-English request.

posts.name: GotEmail
posts.tagline: Native Mac mail. Sign-in codes in one click. Pay once.
posts.description: All your email accounts in one native Mac app. Login codes copy in one click, trackers are blocked, and AI writes when you ask. Gmail, Outlook, iCloud and any IMAP. No subscriptions.

posts.name: SCM
posts.tagline: Open models that turn text + a question into probabilities
posts.description: Open-weight models that turn text + a question into a probability for every answer: choice, yes/no, or score. Self-host them: no API, no bill per call, no data leaving. Weights, sources, licences and a benchmark-overlap audit are published. Github Repo : https://github.com/5ak3t/scm

posts.name: Bulbul V4 Flash
posts.tagline: Expressive Indian-language speech, built for real time
posts.description: Bulbul V4 Flash is Sarvam AI's text-to-speech model built for natural, expressive speech across Indian languages. It delivers under 250 ms time-to-first-audio, with 83 voices across 11 languages and 224 voice-and-style combinations. It's up to 40% faster than Bulbul V3 under comparable load and costs ₹20 per 10,000 characters. Try it through the Sarvam API, Playground, or Content Studio.

posts.name: BasedFrame
posts.tagline: Higgsfield for Interior Design
posts.description: Turn any Zillow listing into your dream home. Basedframe is a canvas-based AI design workspace where you can reimagine interiors, explore different styles, and generate exterior design and cinematic walkthroughs. Go from browsing a listing to seeing what it could become—all before buying or renovating.

posts.name: my-ai-team
posts.tagline: From idea to merged code—your AI team works the backlog.
posts.description: my-ai-team is your AI team. One person can run a company — and still have a life. You own the requirements and acceptance. Your AI team owns delivery and quality.

posts.name: EventSheets
posts.tagline: Find and publish academic conferences worldwide
posts.description: EventSheets is where academic events are published and run, in Arabic and English. Publishing is free: every conference, symposium or workshop gets a page, a place on the calendar and map, and a searchable archive. Organisers can then run it end to end: registration, paper submission, blind peer review by private link, sessions, QR check-in, badges, and PDF certificates anyone can verify. Nothing is taken from participants; the organiser pays once per event.

posts.name: croc-app
posts.tagline: Android client for croc with a modern, mobile-first UI
posts.description: croc-app is an Android client for croc with a modern, mobile-first UI built in Kotlin and Jetpack Compose. It is designed to make file and text sharing feel much more natural on Android: quick send, quick receive, QR-assisted flows, saved codes, transfer history, and better handling for the small details that matter on phones.

posts.name: Distl
posts.tagline: Distl — The useful part, brought forward.
posts.description: Distl is a Chrome extension that turns long articles, emails, AI replies, PDFs, and documents into clear, useful takeaways. Select the text you want to understand, and Distl brings forward the key point, next step, or decision without making you leave the page. It keeps the original context available, so you can move quickly without losing the details that matter. Built for anyone who spends too much time searching through text to find the part worth acting on.

posts.name: Margin
posts.tagline: Margin — The Best & Easiest Scratchpad for Your Browser
posts.description: Boost your browser productivity today! Stop switching tabs or losing track of temporary notes. Margin is an ultra-smooth, local-first scratchpad that sits right beside your work for a friction-free experience. Why You’ll Love It: Instant & Fluid: Open with a shortcut and drag anywhere. Code-Friendly: Built-in editor for quick code snippets. Local-First & Secure: Your notes stay safely on your device.

posts.name: entrevistIA
posts.tagline: Practice job interviews with AI, in Spanish
posts.description: Upload your CV and a job offer, then practice the interview for that exact role. Get tailored questions with feedback, face a live panel of three AI interviewers by voice or text, and finish with an evidence-based report. Built in Spanish. First interview free.

posts.name: Eu Duvido!
posts.tagline: Bluffing trivia party game: bid a number or call EU DUVIDO!
posts.description: A Brazilian party game for iPhone (in Portuguese). Each round asks a question with a number answer nobody knows, like how many km of blood vessels are in your body. Players bid "that or more"; the next one raises or shouts EU DUVIDO! (I doubt it!). Then the answer is revealed and someone loses a life. 2 to 8 players on one phone passed around, or each on their own phone with a room PIN. 700+ hand-picked questions with sources.

posts.name: Dextrous
posts.tagline: Faster prototyping tool for tabletop game designers
posts.description: Fastest and most flexible prototyping design tool for game designers with support for Google Sheets, CMYK PDF export, and exports for Tabletop Simulator, Dustin's Designer Den, Screentop.gg, Tabletopia and more. We also have a load of tutorials and a thriving Discord of designers making cool games.

posts.name: bopomofo
posts.tagline: Learn Taiwan Mandarin, one sound at a time.
posts.description: bopomofo teaches the 37 Bopomofo (Zhuyin) symbols that Taiwan uses to spell Mandarin, so you learn to read without pinyin. Draw each symbol and get stroke-order feedback. Record syllables and get a check on initials, finals, and tones. Train your ear on tones and tone changes. Bobo, the coach, reads your practice stats, picks your next drill, and tells you why. Free and open source (AGPL-3.0).

posts.name: Zigma
posts.tagline: Budget-first money app for where bank sync doesn’t reach
posts.description: Zigma is a budget-first finance app for iPhone, built for countries where bank sync doesn’t work. See what’s left in each category at a glance, and keep track of recurring payments, credit cards, goals and net worth. Bank texts, Apple Wallet payments and bank emails become transactions through Shortcuts, so you type less. In English and Spanish, in your local currency, with widgets and dark mode. No accounts, no servers: your data stays in your iCloud.

posts.name: Verityra: AI-Powered Investment Insights
posts.tagline: Know the deal before you make the decision
posts.description: Verityra combines AI document analysis, cross-document verification, and due diligence workflows in one investment workspace. A customizable 15-rule red-flag engine highlights potential risks, while auto-populated DDQs, Markdown/JSON exports, and deal timelines help teams review opportunities. A free plan lets emerging managers and angel syndicates explore preliminary analysis.

We also have a load of tutorials and a thriving Discord of designers making cool games.

posts.name: CapCar
posts.tagline: Plan every part of your project car in one garage
posts.description: CapCar gives project-car owners one place to plan a build and keep it organized. Track parts, research fitment, compare delivered costs, record maintenance, and follow the car’s progress without juggling spreadsheets, screenshots, bookmarks, and notes. It’s free to start, private by default, and designed around the way real car projects grow over time.

posts.name: WhatYouWrote
posts.tagline: Essay comprehension quizzes inside your LMS
posts.description: Turn a student's essay into a short comprehension quiz inside an LTI 1.3 LMS. Instructors choose the questions and timing, then review responses alongside the submission. Assess understanding without treating a quiz score as proof of authorship.

posts.name: GhostSovereign
posts.tagline: Local-first privacy and security tools for Windows
posts.description: GhostSovereign brings together Windows tools for file protection, Defender scans, evidence records, data control, and authorized network visibility. Built by solo developer Dakota D Garrett at GhostHaven Technologies with a local-first privacy philosophy. One-time purchase with lifetime access; no subscriptions.

posts.name: Daybook
posts.tagline: A free and open source daily planner with a famous painting.
posts.description: An open-source daily planner hung beside 44 public-domain paintings. Plan the morning, shut down in the evening, and let your AI agents do the typing.

posts.name: 100kb-sdk
posts.tagline: Client-side WebAssembly image & PDF optimizer.
posts.description: 100kb-sdk is a client-side WebAssembly image & PDF optimizer for React, Next.js, and HTML. Instead of paying Cloudinary $99/mo, it compresses files 100% in browser RAM in ~25ms before S3 upload. Key Features: • Exact target-KB bisection (e.g. 50KB, 100KB) • Bypasses Vercel's 4.5MB payload limit • 100% GDPR compliant (files never leave device) • Cuts AWS S3 and Lambda costs by 85% • Includes <100kb-uploader> Web Component Free on npm with optional white-label license.

posts.name: Tessera Lite
posts.tagline: Customizable, high-converting portfolios with zero code
posts.description: Junior developers are facing a tough job market where applications go unanswered and resumes get scanned in seconds. A portfolio provides the concrete proof that a resume cannot, but building one from scratch wastes weeks of design, frontend work, and hosting setup that should go into studying and interview prep. At the age of AI, sometimes a developer's focus should be on studying and getting himself out there rather than spending hours building a portfolio. Tessera Lite is meant to solve that.

posts.name: Lam Rimba
posts.tagline: Care for the Wildlife Keep the Forest Alive
posts.description: Most games ask you to fight nature. Lam Rimba asks you to protect it An indie browser based conservation adventure inspired by Indonesia's rainforests. Explore tropical habitats, photograph wildlife, complete forest patrol missions and discover species in the Rimba Dex Built by a solo developer to make wildlife conservation feel like an adventure, not a lecture. Free to play, with optional ways to support its development

posts.name: Codeck
posts.tagline: Switch between Codex and Claude Code tasks on your Mac
posts.description: Stop hunting through windows for your coding agents. Codeck puts Codex and Claude Code tasks in one Mac keyboard switcher, shows task status, and lets you type or dictate new tasks from anywhere. $5 once, plus tax. No subscription.

posts.name: CanvoWP
posts.tagline: Agent-first WordPress website website builder plugin
posts.description: CanvoWP is a free WordPress AI website builder. Describe your site and an AI agent builds real pages and templates. A five page site costs about $0.50.

posts.name: HextaUI Pro
posts.tagline: The hard states of AI product UI, handled, for shadcn/ui
posts.description: Blocks for the parts of AI products that are hard to get right: chat that streams, stops and retries, tool calls that ask first, diff review, artifacts, and the settings screens around them. Installs with the shadcn CLI. One payment, and the library underneath is free and MIT.

posts.name: HiDataLinker
posts.tagline: Free Navicat-style client for MySQL & Postgres — MIT
posts.description: HiDataLinker is a free, MIT-licensed native desktop client for MySQL/PostgreSQL/MS SQL/Oracle — a Navicat-style workflow without the $700 license. Object tree, data grid with dialog edit, DDL viewer, multi-tab SQL editor (format / Explain), dump tosql, and URL-paste connections. Built with Tauri 2 + Rust: cold start under a second, ~90 MB RAM idle. No accounts, no telemetry, no paywall on core features.

posts.name: DocTree
posts.tagline: Turn any topic into a guided reading experience
posts.description: DocTree turns your curiosity into a learning path tailored to your goals, experience, and available time. Explore structured articles with visuals and sources, ask AI about any passage, and keep highlights, notes, and your reading place for next time.

posts.name: PM Book Summaries by AllthingsPM
posts.tagline: 111 product management books, summarized chapter by chapter
posts.description: Free, detailed chapter-by-chapter summaries of 111 books product managers actually read, from Inspired and Continuous Discovery Habits to High Output Management and Atomic Habits. Each chapter is distilled into the product management lessons it teaches, so you get the frameworks without reading every page.
